app.name: Dr. Secret Studio
app.tagline: Private AI production studio for Dr. Secret — catalogue images and cinematic ads with total garment fidelity.

setup.title: Setup
setup.heading: Finish setting up the studio
setup.body: Add these environment variables in Vercel (Project → Settings → Environment Variables), then redeploy.
setup.readme: The README walks through creating the Supabase project, running the migrations and deploying.

compare.slider: Drag to compare original and result

products.title: Products
products.description: Every product starts here: phone photos per piece, then a Garment DNA that locks every detail before anything is generated.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.description: Add your first garment to start the catalogue and ad pipeline.
empty.step1: Create the product and name its pieces (1–3).
empty.step2: Upload front, back and detail photos for every piece.
empty.step3: Let the director brain write the Garment DNA, then review and approve it.

products.photoCount: {count, plural, =0 {No photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}
products.colorwayCount: {count, plural, =0 {No colourways} one {# colourway} other {# colourways}}

form.title: New product
form.description: Name the product, choose its line and name each piece. Photos come next.
form.name: Product name
form.notesPlaceholder: Anything the photos cannot show: fabric composition, exact trims, known issues…

photos.rejected: Some files were skipped — use JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 25 MB.
photos.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded} other {# photos uploaded}}
photos.add: Drop photos or click to choose
photos.label: Label
photos.labelPlaceholder: e.g. Lace hem, pearl buttons, back strap cross

intake.pieceHint: Straight-on, even light, the whole piece in frame. Add close details of lace, trims and closures.

kindHints.detail: Close-ups: lace motif, trims, buttons, seams. Label them.

intake.confirmDelete: Delete this product, its photos and every generation? This cannot be undone.
intake.name: Product name

dna.analyzed: Garment DNA ready — review every field against the photos.
dna.savedAsNew: Saved as new draft v{version} (the approved version stays unchanged until you approve this one).
dna.approved: Garment DNA approved — it now locks every prompt.

empty.title: No Garment DNA yet
empty.description: The DNA is the construction spec every image and video prompt is locked to.
empty.step1: Analyse the photos with the director brain (or start from a blank form).
empty.step2: Check every field against the photos — counts, lace, seams, colours.
empty.step3: Approve it. Generation is locked until then.

dna.gapsHint: The photos did not show these clearly. Add photos or correct the fields below.
dna.editingApproved: Saving changes creates a new draft; the approved version keeps locking prompts until you approve the new one.
dna.isApproved: This version is approved and locks every prompt.
dna.invalidData: This version's data could not be read. Start a new analysis or a blank form.

editor.topToBottom: Top to bottom, one zone per row.
editor.constructionDetail: Exact construction: seams, trims, closures, counts
editor.hardwareHint: Exact counts matter — leave empty only when unsure.
editor.chestPanelHint: Default: unstructured, flat, unlined, unpadded, zero projection.
editor.hasChestPanel: This piece has a chest panel
editor.keyDetailsHint: Selling details become the macro close-ups and product-sheet cards.
editor.doNotAlterHint: Short imperative rules, e.g. “Keep exactly 5 pearl buttons at centre front”.

colorways.intro: Each colourway re-renders the approved front image with only the colour changed. Define it from a fabric swatch photo, an eyedropper sample on a product photo, or a hex value.
colorways.addHint: Name it, then capture the exact colour.

empty.title: No colourways yet
empty.description: Add the colours this product comes in. The Ghost Studio renders them from the approved front image.

colorways.name: Colourway name
colorways.swatchHint: Photograph the fabric flat in daylight. The average colour of the centre is suggested — adjust it if needed.
colorways.badFile: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo up to 25 MB.
colorways.noPhotos: Upload product photos first to sample colours from them.
colorways.manualHint: Type the hex value or pick it with the colour picker.

eyedropper.instruction: Click on the fabric to sample its colour.
eyedropper.failed: Could not read the colour from this photo.

models.references: {count, plural, =0 {No reference images} one {# reference image} other {# reference images}}
models.unverified: Some options are defaults not yet confirmed against Higgsfield's docs.

needDna.title: Approve the Garment DNA first
needDna.description: The product sheet is generated from the approved DNA and the isolated reference photos.

sheet.approved: Sheet approved — {count} isolated reference crops saved.

status.approved: Approved — used by the Ads Director

sheet.notePlaceholder: What should change? e.g. “Hem lace is too dense — match the photo”

empty.title: No product sheet yet
empty.description: A landscape 16:9 board: hero front, back view, six macro details and matching pieces. Once approved it is cut into isolated references for the video ads.
empty.step1: Pick an image model on the right.
empty.step2: Generate — the director brain writes the layout and the DNA lock is appended.
empty.step3: Compare with the originals, then approve to auto-crop the references.

sheet.comparisonHint: Compare every card with these before approving.

crops.title: Isolated reference crops
crops.hint: These crops — never the whole sheet — are passed to the video model, one shot at a time.
crops.adjustHint: Drag a box to move it; drag the round handle to resize. Crops are re-cut from the full-resolution sheet.

generate.title: Generate sheet
generate.hint: Landscape 16:9 at the model's highest resolution.
generate.referencesNote: Isolated references are sent (approved catalogue front/back first, then detail photos), up to the model's limit.

review.hint: Compare the result with the original before approving. Drag the slider or use the arrow keys.
review.notePlaceholder: What exactly should change? Everything else stays locked.

ghost.title: Ghost Mannequin Studio
ghost.description: Catalogue images on an invisible display form, locked to the approved Garment DNA, in one consistent catalogue style.

empty.title: Add a product first
empty.description: Ghost images are generated from a product's photos and its approved Garment DNA.

setup.title: New job
setup.hint: Choose the job type, the products and the model.

front_back.title: Front & Back — exactly 2 images
front_back.description: A straight-on front and back ghost-mannequin image, identical framing, from the isolated front and back photos.

macro.title: Close-up macro — exactly 2 images
macro.description: Advertising-grade close-ups of the two details that sell the product. The director brain picks them from the DNA; you can override.

colorways.title: Colourways — one image per colour
colorways.description: The approved front image re-rendered in each colourway. Only the colour changes; every construction detail stays identical.

products.macroHint: Pick up to two. Default: the two highest-ranked selling details.

ghost.queueBatch: {count, plural, =0 {Queue batch} one {Queue # product} other {Queue # products}}
ghost.queued: {count, plural, one {# job queued} other {# jobs queued}}

noJobs.title: No jobs yet
noJobs.description: Queue a job on the left. Every output opens in the compare view before approval.

ads.title: Ads Director
ads.description: Cinematic product ads planned by the director brain and generated shot by shot from isolated reference crops.
ads.needSheet: Approve a product sheet first — ads are built from its isolated reference crops.

empty.title: No ads yet
empty.description: Every ad is a director board: controls, a shot list and video settings.
empty.step1: Approve a product sheet (it produces the isolated references).
empty.step2: Create an ad, pick a preset and write a short brief.
empty.step3: Plan the shots, edit them, then generate each shot.

presets.title: Director presets
presets.hint: Presets store every director control, the video settings and the rules. Edit them from any board with “Save as preset”.
presets.confirmReset: Restore this preset to its original values?

ads.newHint: Pick a product with an approved sheet and a preset.
ads.name: Ad name
ads.briefPlaceholder: Audience, offer, the feeling you want…

director.title: Director Board
director.description: Controls on the left, storyboard in the centre, video settings on the right.
director.name: Ad name
director.briefPlaceholder: What should this ad achieve? Audience, offer, mood…
director.planned: {count, plural, one {# shot planned} other {# shots planned}}
director.controlsHint: Tap presets, add your own words. Saved with the ad.

noShots.title: No shots yet
noShots.description: Write a brief and press “Plan shots”. Every shot must show a garment detail.
noShots.noCrops: The approved product sheet has no reference crops yet.

montage.title: Montage
montage.description: Order and trim clips, add a music track and render the final video on the render worker.

director.customPlaceholder: Or describe it in your own words…

video.aspectFromReference: This model frames the clip like its reference image. Turn on “preview frame first” on a shot to get an exact 9:16 start frame.
video.fixedDuration: This model sets the clip length itself; clips are trimmed in the montage.

shot.referencesHint: Pick the crops that show exactly this shot's detail.
shot.notePlaceholder: What should change in this shot?
shot.previewApproved: Frame approved — generate the video next.
shot.overLimit: Longer than the preset limit of {seconds}s.

presetDialog.title: Save as preset
presetDialog.hint: Stores the controls, video settings and rules for future ads.
presetDialog.name: Preset name
presetDialog.builtinNote: Built-in presets can always be restored from the Ads page.

home.title: Studio
home.heading: Every stitch, exactly as it is.
home.subheading: Turn phone photos into ghost-mannequin catalogue images and cinematic video ads — with every garment detail locked by its Garment DNA.

recent.hint: Every result is copied to your storage as soon as it finishes.

library.title: Library

settings.description: Director brain, catalogue style, models, integrations and costs. API keys live only in environment variables and are never shown here.

brain.title: Director brain
brain.hint: The LLM that analyses garments and writes every prompt and shot list.

style.title: Catalogue style
style.hint: Shared by every ghost-mannequin image so the store grid stays consistent.

models.title: Image & video models
models.hint: Every model the app can use. Options marked unverified are defaults to confirm against the Higgsfield docs.

custom.title: Custom models (JSON)
custom.hint: Add models from docs.higgsfield.ai without a redeploy. Each entry is validated before saving.
custom.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Custom models cleared} one {# custom model saved} other {# custom models saved}}

keys.title: Provider keys
keys.hint: Status only — values are never displayed.

drive.title: Google Drive
drive.hintConfigured: OAuth client configured. Connecting and mirroring arrive in Phase 2; the target folder can be set now.

drive.autoMirror: Mirror every approved result to Drive (Phase 2)

costs.title: Cost summary
costs.hint: Recorded per generation when the provider returns a cost.

password.title: Account password
password.hint: Replace the temporary password with your own — at least 12 characters.

errors.weak: This password is too weak — try a longer one.
